keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 59,179 km2: the republic of 1940 to 1944 with Petseri County and the Ivangorod strip east of the Narva River, which were ceded to the RSFSR in 1945. Cliopatria's Estonia of 1939 is 48,288 km2 and ends in 1939; the Soviet years lie inside its Union of Soviet Socialist Republics shapes. The German occupation of 1941-1944 is a ledger occupation, not a change of keyframe.

New keyframe, 57,661 km2 against the infobox 45,227 km2 for 1989 (ratio 0.78; the gazetteer overcounts Estonia, whose Natural Earth cells include coast and islands): Estonia within the borders it kept after Petseri County was annexed to the RSFSR in 1945 and the Narva River was fixed as the border in January 1945.

sources.title: Estonian Soviet Socialist Republic
sources.note: 21 July 1940 established, 6 August 1940 annexed; German occupation 1941-1944; January 1945 Narva border and Ivangorod; 1945 Petseri County to the RSFSR; renamed 8 May 1990; 20 August 1991; area 45,227 km2 (1989); capital Tallinn.

notes: No Cliopatria row after 1939 (Cliopatria's Estonia is 1919-1939, its Republic of Estonia 1992 on). The republic is an internal unit of the Soviet Union; its land lies inside Union of Soviet Socialist Republics shapes. The Petseri County and Ivangorod circles (25 km and 8 km) are the researcher's: the page gives no area. The page is silent on the day of the German invasion and of the Soviet return, and on any other 1944 territory transfer. The RSFSR dossier records the matching gains. The Ivangorod "1945, January" and Petseri "1945" dates are the page's; the Latvian page dates the Abrene transfer to 1944. Counterparts: estonia exists (Cliopatria); the RSFSR and nazi-germany dossiers exist or are in this batch.
